findings.title: Exact rendered-text count does not prove the cap in each state
findings.reason: The new manual-rule test uses getAllByText("Platform default (10 per day)").toHaveLength(2) across the whole screen. Two occurrences do not establish that Before and After each show the correct Daily limit, and incidental repeated copy changes the count. Replace the count proxy with scoped assertions on the Daily limit value in each named Before/After state.

findings.title: Run C plan function citations are stale at the reviewed HEAD
findings.reason: Current plan citations no longer land on their named functions: settings.ts:379 lands in audit metadata (lockAccount is line 392); plan lines 208/209 cite process-review.ts:40/552 (origin commentary and response enqueue), while processReview/importReview are lines 81/607. The answered-import citation at plan line 211 should name zernio-ingest-shared.ts:492. Function behavior matches the plan; these are stale anchors, not false behavior claims. Re-anchor these current implementation references or explicitly mark citations as referring to the pinned base.

findings.title: New retained-veto invariant failure has an emitter but no actionable alert rule
findings.reason: The new missing_grants invariant throws from readRetainedVetoCount inside recordPolicyApplied, rolls back Apply and remains unresolved on retry until the retained grant data is repaired. The Apply route at src/app/api/operator/proposals/[id]/apply/route.ts:108 reports the caught Error via report-caught-error.ts:27, emitting endpoint=api/operator/proposals/[id]/apply POST with default error level and exception-stack grouping. beta-launch-alerting.md contains no matching endpoint/invariant rule, cadence or destination action. Its rule 11 requires subsystem=worker_job AND queue=agent_turn, which this Next.js Apply event does not carry. Add a rule for the actual emitted failure and document grouping, repeat cadence/throttle and operator action; do not claim staging delivery from this static comparison.
